app.name: Tideline
app.tagline: The operating platform for ferry, crew-boat and offshore vessel operators.

hero.title: The operating system for your fleet
hero.bodyStart: Manifests, safety checks, certificates and charters in one place — on any phone,

start.label: Your phone number
start.note: Free during the pilot · No card needed

platform.title: Your whole operation, in one calm place
platform.body: One record for every boat, crew member, trip and certificate — shared by the owner, the office and the captain at the jetty.

crew.title: Captains in the loop
crew.body: Captains log trips from their phone or a WhatsApp voice note, and you see it as it happens.

safety.title: A safety lock on every departure
safety.body: Weather, daylight, capacity and documents are checked before a boat can leave the jetty.

demo.aria: Four check layers stacked under a trip: weather, daylight, capacity and documents

connect.title: Connected where you work
connect.body: WhatsApp, SMS, card and transfer payments, live weather and maps — already wired in.

process.title: How a voyage runs on Tideline
process.body: Every trip follows the same loop: plan it, check it, sail it, close it. The record builds itself as you go.

steps.title: Plan the day
steps.body: Routes, schedules and crew are set once. Captains open today’s trips on their phone.

steps.title: Check before departure
steps.body: The safety lock runs weather, daylight, capacity and document checks, in plain words.

steps.title: Track the voyage
steps.body: The captain’s phone shares position. Passengers see a public status page, no personal data.

steps.title: Close and report
steps.body: Takings, passengers and fuel roll up into a daily report for the owner, by boat and by route.

modes.title: Ferry, charter and compliance on one platform
modes.body: Turn on the modes your business runs. Vessels, crew, documents and payments are shared underneath.

ferry.title: Fill every seat, safely.
ferry.body: Manifests, tickets and takings for scheduled and ad-hoc trips, built for a busy jetty.
bullets: Scan a QR code to board

charter.title: Win the tender. Get paid on time.
charter.body: Tender packs from your own documents, quotes and contracts, invoices, and escrow so both sides know the money is there.

compliance.title: Never sail on an expired certificate.
compliance.body: Photograph a certificate and Tideline reads the dates for you to confirm. Alerts go out long before anything lapses.

field.title: Built for the water, not the office

items.title: Works offline
items.body: Trips, manifests and safety checks save on the phone and sync when the signal returns.

items.title: Voice notes count
items.body: “Trip four, CMS to Ikorodu, eighteen passengers” becomes a logged trip after one tap.

items.title: Any phone
items.body: Light enough for a low-cost Android on a slow network, readable in full sun.

items.a: It helps, but it isn’t required. Captains can log trips by WhatsApp voice note or by a short SMS, and the office can enter trips for them.

items.q: What happens when there’s no signal on the water?
items.a: Captain screens work offline. Trips, manifests and safety checks are saved on the phone and sync automatically when the connection returns.

items.q: Can a captain override the safety lock?
items.a: No. A blocked trip can only depart with the owner’s recorded approval, and an overloaded boat can’t depart at all.
Online by card, transfer or USSD, or in cash at the jetty. Every ticket gets a code the crew scans at boarding.

items.q: Is passenger and crew data safe?
items.a: Data is encrypted, each company only sees its own records, and we follow the data-protection law of every country we operate in.
We’re launching in Nigeria with Lagos ferry operators and offshore support vessels. Other countries follow as we validate each market.

cta.title: Bring your fleet on board.
cta.body: We’re onboarding our first ferry and crew-boat operators now. Start with one boat; add the rest when you’re ready.

footer.line: The operating platform for vessel operators.
